The Saints, led by second-year head coach [[Carmen Maciariello]], played their home games at the [[Alumni Recreation Center]] in [[Loudonville, New York]] as members of the [[Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 12–5, 12–4 in [[2020–21 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference men's basketball season|MAAC play]] to finish in a tie for first place. As the No. 1 seed in the [[2021 MAAC men's basketball tournament|MAAC tournament]], they were upset in the quarterfinals by No. 9 seed [[2020–21 Iona Gaels men's basketball team|Iona]] 52–55. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Siena Saints men's basketball team|Saints]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 20–10 overall, 15–5 in MAAC play to finish in first place. As the No. 1 seed in the [[2020 MAAC men's basketball tournament|MAAC tournament]], they defeated No. 9 seed [[2019–20 Manhattan Jaspers basketball team|Manhattan]] 63–49 in the quarterfinals. However, the semifinals and championship game, and all postseason tournaments, were cancelled amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]]. == Roster == {{CBB
